verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a government filing and records service, for example batch filings or bulk entity searches. The evidence pack documents only single-item, per-document workflows: a fee for each name searched, per-document expedite fees, and individual certificate filings. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec, and the online filing host refused connections, so no bulk or batch capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
